WALLS / WITH PERMISSION

THE WALL IS PUBLIC.
THE PERMISSION IS SPECIFIC.

Le M.U.R. Oberkampf · 107 rue Oberkampf
A changing, association-curated exhibition. View the work from the street. Painting requires the organizer’s explicit agreement; it is not a free-paint wall.
Organizer and current programme ↗

Vitry-sur-Seine · Mur/Murs
Municipally supported projects connect artists and residents. A commissioned mural does not grant general permission to paint neighbouring walls.
City’s documented programme ↗

05 / A WAY OF SEEING

LOOK CLOSER.
QUESTION THE STORY.
MAKE SOMETHING.

A city holds more than one truth at a time. Stone carries history. A wall carries a voice. A repeated shape can become a question. A rhythm can become your first honest bar.

CAISIK Underground Alchemy connects those encounters. Walk with attention. Separate what you can document from what you imagine. Let the space between them become creative material.

PHYSICALHISTORICALSYMBOLICUNDERGROUNDPSYCHOLOGICALCREATIVE

THE RESEARCH STANDARD

EVIDENCE FIRST.
INTERPRETATION OPEN.

Historical evidence comes from monument operators, museums, municipal archives and cultural institutions. Each location links to its sources.

Symbolic interpretation is labelled as a contemporary CAISIK reading. Similarity is not proof of a secret plan. The exercises invite reflection, not historical or scientific certainty.

Access is venue-specific. Published information was checked on 21 October 2026; hours, access and street conditions can change. Approximate map positions are not accessibility guarantees.
